blocks.text: West Newton homes listed and sold, June to October 2026

West Newton, October 2026. Detached houses: 89 listed at month end and 8 sold in October, a sales ratio of 9% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 107 listed at month end and 18 sold in October, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 51 sold over 5 months against an average of 95.2 listed, about 9.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 17 sold. Condos and townhomes: 51 sold over 5 months against an average of 121.4 listed, about 11.9 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was October with 18 sold.

faq.a: The R1 RapidBus on King George Boulevard (Newton Exchange to Guildford Exchange), the R6 Scott Road RapidBus on the west edge (Scott Road Station to Newton Exchange), and routes 323 and 364 through the area — two RapidBus corridors connecting to Expo Line stations.

faq.q: Is West Newton in a floodplain or the ALR?
faq.a: The residential upland is outside the Serpentine & Nicomekl lowland floodplain, which lies to the south and is dyke-protected; the south end of the plan area falls toward those lowlands, and a specific property's flood and ALR status must be checked on the City's flood mapping and the Agricultural Land Commission's maps.

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in West Newton?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 89 houses listed with 8 sold in the month and 107 condos and townhomes listed with 18 sold in the month in West Newton. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is West Newton a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 9%, a buyers’ market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 17%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
